1. cp infrastructure/base/traefik/helmchartconfig.yaml.backup infrastructure/base/traefik/helmchartconfig.yaml

Add Home button after Keycloak logout — post_logout_redirect_uri
description:
After signing out, users land on Keycloak's own logout page with no way back to nodeposit.kubetest.uk.

Fix:
1. Add postLogoutRedirectUris=["https://nodeposit.kubetest.uk"] to the no-deposit-app Keycloak client in keycloak-setup-job.yaml (create + update paths)
2. Update sign-out href in base_portal.html and landing.html to include client_id=no-deposit-app&post_logout_redirect_uri=https://nodeposit.kubetest.uk in the Keycloak end-session URL

Correct sign-out href:
/oauth2/sign_out?rd=https%3A%2F%2Fauth.kubetest.uk%2Frealms%2Fno-deposit%2Fprotocol%2Fopenid-connect%2Flogout%3Fclient_id%3Dno-deposit-app%26post_logout_redirect_uri%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fnodeposit.kubetest.uk

After this change Keycloak ends the SSO session and redirects back to nodeposit.kubetest.uk automatically — no Keycloak logout page shown.

Need to investigate oauth2-proxy post-login redirect behaviour and decide whether to: (a) make / auto-redirect based on role, or (b) fix the redirect destination after login/logout to always land on /.

title: Keycloak Phase 1: smoke test (all 9 must pass)
description:
Run all 9 checks:
1. Pod 1/1 Running
2. Watch logs for startup (kubectl logs -n keycloak -l app=keycloak -f)
3. PVC Bound
4. Ingress ADDRESS populated
5. DNS resolves (dig auth.kubetest.uk)
6. /health/ready returns {"status":"UP"} publicly
7. OIDC issuer = https://auth.kubetest.uk/realms/master
8. /admin from internet returns 403
9. /admin from Tailscale device loads Admin Console
(+) cluster-internal DNS: curl http://keycloak.keycloak.svc.cluster.local:8080/health/ready

All 9 must pass before Phase 2 (Django) can start.
